title: EvalRunOpenResponse
description:
Server response to a successful [`EvalRunOpenRequest`].

`run_id` is the existing core [`RunId`]. An eval execution is a `Run` of the referenced Eval card under the Card/Spec/Run/Observation ontology, so no eval-specific run-id noun is introduced.

lease_token.description: Opaque lease the client returns on every subsequent call.

run_id.description: Server-generated handle for the leased eval run.
